# Reshi

Reshi uses a warm green and yellow-gold palette with balanced grays, offered in light and dark modes. It adds Lucide-icon checkboxes, two themed textboxes, a sparkle callout, colorized bold and italics and the removal of link underlines. CSS adjustments are included for Dataview, Obsidian Columns and Multi-Column Markdown, with Noto Sans and JetBrains Mono as the fonts.

![Reshi screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/contrapasso3/Reshi/HEAD/Reshi%20Preview.png)
